description: This Python script provides utility functions for extracting GUI component and screen terms from a JSON trace, checking for term presence in source files, and mapping terms to source code files within a project.

methods.name: extract_sc_terms
methods.description: Extracts screen component (SC) terms from a JSON string representing execution trace data.

methods.name: extract_gs_terms
methods.description: Extracts GUI screen (GS) terms from a JSON string representing execution trace data.

methods.name: check_if_sc_term_exists
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified SC or GS terms are present in a given file's content.

methods.name: build_corpus
methods.description: Maps SC terms to source code files using a brute-force search.

methods.name: get_boosted_files
methods.description: Identifies source code files that match given GS terms based on filename matching.
